prompt: Given this Squid excerpt — `acl Safe_ports port 80 443 1025-65535`, `acl CONNECT method CONNECT`, `http_access deny !Safe_ports`, `http_access deny CONNECT !SSL_ports`, `http_access allow localnet` — which statement is true?
choices: An `http_access` rule denying everyone must be added at the end
Users who connect to `localhost` can access web sites through this proxy
This proxy can access SSL sites by listening on any port
This proxy is misconfigured and no user can access web sites
This proxy cannot be used to access FTP servers listening on the standard port
explanation: FTP's standard port (`21`) is not listed in `Safe_ports`, so `http_access deny !Safe_ports` blocks requests to FTP servers on that port.
